setup.name: EDCeleste with everything that leaves the computer faked

steps.name: The preflight opens the dashboard without waiting
No request can reach a real LLM by mistake
The voice profiles go to a voices folder in the temp folder
A click waits until its target is on the screen
A fake keyboard and mouse that the Commander uses anywhere on the computer
A clock for the speech queue that the test can move on
A fake microphone and a Whisper that hears what the test says
An empty journal and the test keybindings in a temp folder
A config.yaml pointing at them, every event reaction off
The Instinct model in the temp folder, no Hugging Face Hub
A fake keyboard and a game window that is always in front
A fake speaker that remembers what Celeste says and plays, voices without network
LLM models and microphones listed without network
An LLM that answers only what the test scripts
